mingshi:136:p118: s0374 大祀禮專用安議，其餘參匯諸說，從其所長：祫禘用詹同，時享用硃升，釋奠、耕耤用錢用壬，五祀用崔亮，朝會用劉基，祝祭用魏觀，軍禮用陶凱。
The Chinese gives the later 魏觀 / 魏瓘 or 敻子瓘 of Northern Zhou, rather than the Jin Grand Guardian 衛瓘. Distinct family/career and polity; romanization does not bridge them.
The root is Grand Guardian 衛瓘, father of Ting, of the Western Jin crown-prince household (jinshu:053:s0205); existing members identify the same Jin minister and Wei military official.
